messages:
kevin: FYI — NewCo wants a tight POC run next week. Key asks: SSO (SAML with central IdP), SCIM across 3 domains (corp, infra, apps), group -> RBAC mapping, delegated admin for tenant ops, and domain ownership proofing. Also asked how SCIM delta scaling affects pricing. Sending their questionnaire link: https://docs.google.com/q/abc123

priya: Thanks — can we confirm scope first: will they expect full bi-directional provisioning or inbound-only? That changes SCIM webhook needs and rate expectations. I think NewCo wants one-way (IdP -> Redwood) but with delta/full sync fallback.

kevin: Confirmed inbound-only with full fallback. They also have multiple AD forests, so group membership claims may span 100k users across the domains.

sam: Security Qs I started filling: they want KMS integration (customer-managed key), SAML assertions signed with SHA256, and audit logs retained 1 year. Short answers: KMS via HW-backed keys is supported on Private, SAML SHA256 supported, audit retention configurable (needs enterprise SLA). I'll attach a short answers doc to the RFP.

elena: Technical notes for the POC:
- SCIM: recommend starting with delta sync at 1m cadence for delta window < 5000 changes; plan for hourly full sync.
- For >50k group membership churn, enable paging and chunked membership writes (we support groups up to 100k but recommend batching in 5k chunks).
- Domain proofing: DNS TXT + file upload both supported; for multiple domains we can pipeline proofs but need separate validation tasks.

elena: Example SCIM patch we ask them to use for testing (short):
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/1234
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "replace", "path": "members", "value": [{"value":"user-5678","display":"a.smith@example.com"}]}
  ]
}
```

jordan: Pricing implication: high SCIM write QPS + large membership churn pushes them into a Dedicated-plan conversation. Rough numbers: if they run 1m delta every minute with peak 10k writes/min, estimate 2-3x token-equivalent throughput; we should price as reserved capacity. I'll draft a delta pricing addendum.

kevin: Can we get a quick checklist for the SE-run POC next Tue? I need a 30m pre-call with their infra lead and 90m joint session.

priya: SE checklist (short):
1) Pre-call: confirm IdP metadata and test user credentials.
2) Provision a POC org on Private/Dedicated preview.
3) Run sample SCIM delta (elena's payload) + show full sync.
4) Validate group -> role mapping UI and RBAC assignment flows.
5) Demonstrate domain proofing via DNS TXT.
6) Walk security answers and KMS choices.
7) Capture logs and perf numbers (latency + QPS) and upload to the ticket.

sam: Also add: capture JWT SAML assertion samples and check replay detection. Request that NewCo provide 10 sample assertions for testing.

kevin: Great. I've asked NewCo for IdP metadata and 10 sample assertions. I'll post them when I have them.

jira-bot: Created ticket INF-7083 with checklist and links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7083

priya: Final ask — if NewCo insists on customer-managed KMS + HSM for keys, we'll need legal signoff for Private deployment. flagging legal + security. :eyes:

kevin: Noted. I'll loop in legal if they push KMS. Thanks team, will update when I get the metadata.
